title: s3-GCC Protocol for Nuclei Isolation and Tn5 Generation
author: Andrew Adey
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.beb4jaqw
materials: Combine the following reagents for a RT-PCR reaction directly to the 96 well plate contained the samples. ddH2O, Q5U Master Mix and 100X SYBR can be made as a mastermix prior to added to wells. PCR primers (S70x (TruSeq i7) and N50x (Nextera i5) we sent last time) to final conc. 500nM 2.5 uL each primer Sample 16.5 ul H2O 3 uL Q5U 25 ul 100X SYBR 0.5uL Total 50 ul for PCR

Concentrate DNA via column clean up Run full pool volume through Qiaquick PCR purification column following manufacturer's protocol. Qiagen QIAquick PCR Purification Kit Protocol by Michael Crone Elute in 50 µL, 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0 .
Use Tapestation software to quantify DNA from 200-1000bp size. Dilute library to 1nM and prepare for sequencing following Illumina protocols.

Concentrate DNA via column clean up Run full pool volume through Qiaquick PCR purification column following manufacturer's protocol. Qiagen QIAquick PCR Purification Kit Protocol by Michael Crone Elute in 50 µL, 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0 .

steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Buffers
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary buffers and oligonucleotides before starting the procedure.

substeps.instruction: Prepare iTSM plate and order oligonucleotides (iTSM, sci_WG, A14_ME_LNA, PCR_i5 primers, PCR_i7 primers) as per s3_oligos.xlsx.
Generate and purify pTXB1.Tn5 enzyme.
Load Tn5 enzyme: combine a single oligonucleotide and mosaic end reverse compliment oligonucleotide to a final concentration of equimolar 2.5uM each with 2.5uM Tn5.

Construct 50mL Nuclei Isolation Buffer (NIB-Tris): 500 uL 1M Tris HCl (pH 7.5), 100 uL 5M NaCl, 150 uL 1M MgCl2, 500 uL 10% Igepal, 500 uL 10% Tween, and ddH2O to volume. Optional: add 2 Pierce Protease Inhibitor Tablets (EDTA-Free) and vortex.

Construct 50mL Nuclei Isolation Buffer (NIB-HEPES): 500 uL 1M Tris HCl (pH 7.5), 100 uL 5M NaCl, 150 uL 1M MgCl2, 500 uL 10% Igepal, 500 uL 10% Tween, and ddH2O to volume. Optional: add 2 Pierce Protease Inhibitor Tablets (EDTA-Free) and vortex.
Construct 5mL 10X NEBuffer 2.1: 500 uL 5M NaCl, 500 uL 1M Tris HCl (pH 7.5), 500 uL 1M MgCl2, 50 uL 100ng/uL BSA, and 3450 uL H2O (pH 7.9 @ 25C). Dilute to 1X before use.

steps.title: Isolate Nuclei from Adherent Cells
steps.instruction: Harvest and isolate nuclei from adherent cultured cell lines.

substeps.instruction: Plate 1 million cells in T25 flask the day prior; harvest while subconfluent.
Aspirate media and wash cells in flask with 5 mL ice-cold 1X PBS, then aspirate.
Add 5 mL TrypLE to flask and incubate at 37 °C for 15 minutes.
Collect cells into a 15mL tube on ice.
Spin down nuclei solution at 4 °C.
Resuspend pellet in 1 mL NIB:HEPES and incubate on ice for 10 minutes.
Repeat the spin down and resuspension for a second wash.
Resuspend cells in 300 µL NIB:HEPES and hold on ice.

steps.title: Quantify and Aliquot Nuclei
steps.instruction: Determine the concentration of isolated nuclei and prepare standardized aliquots.

substeps.instruction: Dilute 10uL of nuclei suspension in 90 µL NIB:HEPES (1:10 dilution).
Determine nuclei/uL concentration using a Hemocytometer or BioRad TC20 Automated Cell Counter.
Separate nuclei into 1 million nuclei aliquots (or up to 3M) and transfer into 5mL tubes.
Add NIB:HEPES to suspend the 1M nuclei aliquots in a total volume of 5 mL.

steps.title: Fix and Deplete Nuclei
steps.instruction: Fix nuclei with formaldehyde and remove nucleosomes using SDS.

substeps.instruction: Add 246 µL 16% formaldehyde to the 5mL nuclei suspension (final concentration 0.75%).
Incubate at Room Temperature for 10 minutes on an orbital shaker at 50 rpm.
Centrifuge at 500 x g, 4 °C for 5 minutes; aspirate supernatant.
Wash pellet with 1 mL NIB:Tris to quench formaldehyde; centrifuge at 500 x g, 4 °C for 5 minutes and aspirate.
Wash pellet with 200 µL ice-cold 1X NEBuffer 2.1; transfer to 1.5mL tube and centrifuge at 500 x g, 4 °C for 5 minutes and aspirate.
Resuspend pellet in 760 µL 1X NEBuffer 2.1.
Add 40 µL 1% SDS (final concentration 0.05%) and incubate at 37 °C, 300 rpm for 20 minutes on a ThermoMixer.
Centrifuge at 500 x g, 4 °C for 5 minutes and aspirate supernatant.

steps.title: Final Nuclei Preparation and Counting
steps.instruction: Resuspend and quantify the fixed, nucleosome-depleted nuclei.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in 50 µL NIB:Tris (pool replicates here if necessary). If clumping occurs, incubate 10 min in NIB:Tris and triturate or use a Dounce homogenizer (loose strokes B).
Dilute 5uL of nuclei suspension in 45 µL NIB:Tris (1:10 dilution).
Determine nuclei/uL concentration via Hemocytometer or BioRad TC20, accounting for debris.

steps.title: Perform Tagmentation
steps.instruction: Tagment the nuclei using Tn5 transposase in an iTSM plate.

substeps.instruction: Combine 420 µL of 500 nuc/uL solution with 540 µL 2X TD Buffer.
Pipette 8uL of this mixture per well of a 96-well iTSM plate.
Add 1uL of 2.5uM uniquely indexed SBS12-U-ME TSM per well (Total volume 9uL).
Keep the SBS12-U-ME TSM plate, nuclei, and tagmentation plate on ice during preparation.
Incubate at 55 °C for 10 minutes while shaking at 300 rpm.
Place plate on ice for 2 minutes to cool.

steps.title: Sort and Process Tagmented Nuclei
steps.instruction: Pool tagmented nuclei, stain with DAPI, and sort into a new plate.

substeps.instruction: Pool the full plate on ice and add 2 µL 5mg/mL DAPI. Strain through a 40um cell strainer if chunks are visible.
Prepare a 96-well plate with 9 µL 1X TD Buffer (diluted with ddH2O) per well.
Using a cell sorter (e.g., Sony SH800S), sort 15 DAPI+ nuclei per well into the prepared plate (maintain sample chamber and pool at 4 °C).
Centrifuge the plate at 500 x g, 4 °C for 5 minutes. (Safe stop: store at -20 °C for 1 week).

steps.title: Gap-Fill and Adapter Extension
steps.instruction: Perform gap-filling and linear extension to switch adapters.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 µL 0.1% SDS to each well.
Add 4 µL NPM to each well (must be added step-wise, not pre-combined with SDS).
Incubate at 72 °C for 10 minutes for gap-fill, then hold on ice.
Add 1.5 µL 1uM A14-LNA_ME to a final concentration of 100 nM.
Perform 10 cycles of linear extension: 98 °C (30s), 98 °C (10s), 59 °C (20s), 72 °C (10s). Hold at 10 °C.

steps.title: Library Amplification
steps.instruction: Amplify libraries via real-time PCR and monitor with SYBR fluorescence.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 µL 1% (v/v) Triton X-100 to quench SDS (10:1 TritonX:SDS ratio). (Safe stop: store at -20 °C for 10 weeks or 4 °C for 5 weeks).
Perform real-time PCR (15-17 cycles): 98 °C (30s), 98 °C (10s), 55 °C (20s), 72 °C (30s), measure SYBR fluorescence, 72 °C (10s).
Stop PCR when fluorescence stops exponential growth; hold at 72 °C for 2 minutes, then hold at 10 °C.

steps.title: Library Cleanup and Quantification
steps.instruction: Clean the pooled PCR products and quantify the resulting DNA.

substeps.instruction: Pool 25 uL from each well into a 15mL conical tube.
Perform 1X SPRI bead size selection (selecting for DNA > 200 bp).
Add 50 µL MagPure NGS Binding Beads (vortex stock 10s), incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Place on magnetic rack for 2 minutes; discard elution.
Wash bead pellet twice with 100 µL 80% ethanol (v/v); discard ethanol after each wash.
Spin briefly on tabletop centrifuge, return to rack, and remove remaining ethanol.
Resuspend beads in 31 µL 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0; incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Place on magnetic rack for 2 minutes and transfer elution to a clean tube.
Quantify DNA concentration using 1uL sample with Qubit DNA High-sensitivity kit.
Dilute sample to 2 ng/uL using 10mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0 and run 2 uL on Agilent Tapestation 4150 (D5000 or D1000).
Load libraries according to Illumina standard loading concentrations.

steps.title: Optional: Restriction Digest and Proximity Ligation
steps.instruction: Alternative processing for restriction digest and proximity ligation.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge nuclei at 500 x g, 4 °C for 5 minutes and aspirate.
Resuspend pellet in 90 µL 1X Cutsmart Buffer.
Add 10 µL 10 U/uL AluI Enzyme and incubate at 37 °C, 300 rpm for 2 hours on a ThermoMixer.
Centrifuge at 500 x g, 4 °C for 5 minutes and aspirate.
Resuspend nuclei in 100uL of proximity ligation mixture and incubate at 16 °C overnight (12-16 hours).
Centrifuge at 500 x g, 4 °C for 5 minutes and aspirate.
Resuspend pellet in 200 µL NIB:HEPES.
Dilute 5uL of nuclei suspension in 45 µL NIB:HEPES (1:10 dilution) and determine concentration via Hemocytometer or BioRad TC20.
Dilute nuclei to 500 nuclei/uL with NIB:HEPES.
